long_biography.plain_text:
Yorgen Fenech helped assemble the consortium that developed Malta's gas-fired Delimara power station. He held a personal equity interest alongside his family's Tumas Group and served on the power company's board. The undertaking gave him a major project beyond the property, hotel and gaming businesses that had shaped Tumas.

Within the family company, Fenech had overseen the completion of several property developments before moving into gaming. He became an executive director and later chief executive, while the group continued to expand across its established businesses. He resigned his Tumas and Electrogas directorships in 2019.
